message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "Expand", "method": "extractFile", "explanation": "In Expand.extractFile, the archive entry name from ZipEntry.getName() is passed as entryName to FileUtils.resolveFile(dir, entryName), and the resulting File f is used directly in new FileOutputStream(f). There is no containment check or allow-list ensuring the resolved file remains under the destination directory dir, so a malicious entry name such as ../ can escape the extraction directory."}]}
